stemMd: A printer has a setup cost of 84 euros and a unit cost of 1.20 euros. How many copies give a total cost of 264 euros?
explanationMd: Subtract setup: 264-84=180 euros remain for copies. Divide by 1.20 to obtain 150 copies.

distractorRationale.d: Divides the full total by unit cost.
distractorRationale.c: Reports the residual cost as the number of copies.
